name: Stars End
source:
Qi lived an idyllic life, finding home in a little coastal cottage and working as a baker in the tiny village nearby.

But no one knew where Qi came from, not even their best friend...

They just appeared, all by themself, seven years ago. 

And one day... 

They were called back. 

To family, was all the villagers knew, but none of them could ever imagine... what that actually meant.

You guide Qi through a world of wizards with questionable morals, lost souls desperate to revive their fallen queendom, and mysterious figures attempting to fix age-old conflicts behind the scenes.

But above all, you seek to reclaim the life that was so abruptly taken.

And in the process, there will be two people that will leave an impression on Qi, in whichever way you will let them...

[From [url=https://uintie.itch.io/stars-end]itch.[/url]]
translation:
齐过着田园诗般的生活，在一座沿海小屋里安家，并在附近的小村庄里当面包师。

但没有人知道琪是从哪里来的，就连他们最好的朋友也不知道……

他们是在七年前独自出现的。

而有一天… 

他们被召回了。

对于家人，这是村民们所知道的一切，但没有人能够想象……这到底意味着什么。

你带领齐穿越一个道德可疑的巫师、渴望复兴堕落女王的迷失灵魂以及试图解决幕后古老冲突的神秘人物的世界。

但最重要的是，你要努力夺回突然被夺走的生活。

而在这个过程中，会有两个人给琪留下印象，无论你让他们以哪种方式……

[来自[url=https://uintie.itch.io/stars-end]itch.[/url]]
